title: Nourishing Tender Irish Lamb Braise
description: A classic Irish dish featuring tender lamb, fluffy potatoes, and a tangy jam-based sauce, all cooked to perfection in one pot. This recipe is a great weeknight option.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set it aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the caraway seeds and cook for 1 minute.
Sprinkle the flour over the onion mixture and cook for 1 minute.
Slowly add the beef broth, whisking constantly, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Return the lamb to the pot and add the Irish jam, rosemary sprigs, and potatoes.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the lamb until tender and the potatoes are cooked through, about 2-3 hours.
Serve the lamb and potatoes hot, garnished with extra rosemary if desired.
